Heavy rains cause disruptions and infrastructure issues across India

Several Indian states have experienced significant disruptions due to heavy rainfall, leading to school closures and infrastructure damage. Landslides have impacted road and rail services in Maharashtra, particularly on the Mumbai-Pune Expressway. In Mumbai, numerous trees have fallen, prompting discussions about urban planning and safety measures, with the BMC planning a large flood-mitigation project.
